ideas.title: Investigating Minnesota Welfare Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the claims of Minnesota welfare fraud and determine the extent of the issue.
questions: What is the extent of the welfare fraud in Minnesota?
ideas.insight: I believe that investigating the claims of Minnesota welfare fraud could lead to a significant story, as the issue appears to be widespread and involves a large amount of money. I would recommend starting by reviewing public records and conducting interviews with officials involved in the investigation.
